title: evaluation.requested.v1
description: Evaluation of a completed session was asked for. Carries the pinned inputs rather than only the session, so that a replay evaluates against what was in force at the time instead of whatever is current.

bundle_digest.description: The immutable bundle the session ran against.

rubric_version.description: Which version of it, pinned. A rubric edited afterwards must not change what this evaluation meant.
